vm.app.title: Virtual Machine
vm.app.subtitle: Windows and Linux desktop VMs
vm.welcome.title: Welcome to Virtual Machine
vm.welcome.lead: Run Windows and Linux desktops at near-native speed on Apple silicon. Shared host folders, two-way clipboard and automatic resolution on window resize all work out of the box.
vm.welcome.createDesc: Pick a guest system, assign CPU and memory, attach an installer image and start installing within a minute.
vm.empty.title: No machines yet
vm.empty.lead: Use “New machine” in the top right to create one, or import an existing image.
vm.list.noSelection: Select a machine on the left
vm.create.title: New machine
vm.create.name: Name
vm.create.archHint: Only arm64 guests can use native virtualization on Apple silicon; x86_64 requires QEMU emulation and is slow.
vm.create.diskHint: Created as a sparse file, so it only takes real space as the guest writes.
vm.create.installerHint: Pick an ISO, or leave empty to boot straight from the system disk.
vm.create.sharedDirsHint: Works out of the box on Linux guests: mount -t virtiofs <tag> /mnt/<tag>
vm.settings.title: Machine settings
vm.settings.clipboardHint: The guest needs spice-vdagent (Linux) or spice-guest-tools (Windows).
vm.settings.autoResizeHint: Pushes the new display mode to the guest while you resize the window.
vm.rosetta.label: Rosetta (x86_64 translation)
vm.rosetta.hint: Lets a Linux guest run x86_64 binaries without switching guest architecture.
vm.rosetta.notInstalled: Rosetta is not installed. Run softwareupdate --install-rosetta in a terminal, then restart the host app.
vm.rosetta.notSupported: Rosetta is not supported on this host (Apple silicon required).
vm.console.waitingHint: Press “Start” above and the guest screen shows up here.
vm.console.agentHint: If the clipboard does not work, install spice-vdagent inside the guest.
vm.console.engineFallback: The current engine cannot embed the screen; the VM runs in QEMU's own window.
vm.console.mountHint: Inside the guest run: mount -t virtiofs {tag} /mnt/{tag}
vm.console.clipboardHint: Two-way clipboard is on; copying needs spice-vdagent inside the guest.
vm.console.detached: Screen detached into its own window
vm.delete.confirmDetail: “{name}” and its disk image will be removed permanently.
vm.error.load: Failed to load the machine list
vm.error.noEngine: No virtualization engine is available on this system
vm.error.desktopOnly: Virtual machines require the OTools desktop app. A browser has no virtualization capability, so machines cannot be created or started here.
vm.error.hostOutdated: This build of OTools lacks the virtualization entitlement. Update OTools to {version} or later before starting a virtual machine.
vm.clone.title: Clone machine
vm.clone.hint: Uses copy-on-write on APFS: completes in seconds and takes almost no extra space until the new machine actually writes.
vm.resize.title: Resize disk
vm.resize.hint: Growing only — shrinking would destroy guest data. Afterwards extend the partition and filesystem inside the guest: growpart + resize2fs on Linux, “Extend Volume” in Windows Disk Management.
vm.snapshot.saveHint: Save the whole machine (including memory) to disk and stop it; survives closing the app or rebooting, pick up with Resume
vm.snapshot.restoreHint: Resume from the suspended state (works even after closing the app or rebooting)
vm.snapshot.unsupported: Suspend is not supported for this configuration
